text: Yeah so i think if you could get it to a state where, and this is quite the ask im going to put on the table: in the file menu, have Globals -> Animation open up a side by side of the player model and a web cam feed, be able to (ideally) get some form of live sync as best you can for the identification of body parts. probably will take a lot of tweaking to get it right (unless we are lucky or its actually not as hard as i think it is) but this is a good start, and naturally lets us progress into a 'record' state from it
